title: Mapping Spotify User Listening Trends
text:
Overview
🔗 View full project blog post
This project maps a user’s Spotify listening history to countries around the world, using:

Web scraping of Spotify weekly charts from kworb.net
A SQLite database of top songs by country
Spotify’s Web API (via Spotipy) to get a user’s top songs and artists
A Plotly Dash web app to visualize:

Top tracks

Top artists

Recommended countries based on music overlap





Data Pipeline

Web scraping Spotify weekly charts with BeautifulSoup

Cleaning and combining charts into a single country-level CSV

Loading data into a SQLite database

Querying the DB to match a user’s top tracks to countries

Computing a country score based on how many top tracks appear in each country’s charts

Visualizing results with Plotly / Dash
